title: Feeding the 4,000 and Peter's Confession

questions.question: How many days had the crowd been with Jesus before He decided to feed them in Mark 8?
options: Three days
Seven days
Two weeks
Forty days
questions.explanation: Mark 8:2 (ESV): "I have compassion on the crowd, because they have been with me now three days and have nothing to eat."

questions.question: How many loaves of bread did the disciples have available to feed the crowd of 4,000?
options: Seven
Five
Twelve
Three
questions.explanation: Mark 8:5 (ESV): "And he asked them, 'How many loaves do you have?' They said, 'Seven.'"

questions.question: After the 4,000 ate and were satisfied, how many large baskets full of broken pieces were taken up?
options: Seven
Twelve
Four
Seventy
questions.explanation: Mark 8:8 (ESV): "And they ate and were satisfied. And they took up the broken pieces left over, seven baskets full."

questions.question: When the Pharisees came to argue with Jesus, what did they ask for to test Him?
options: A sign from heaven
A miracle to cure a blind Pharisee
For him to pay the temple tax immediately
For Him to explain the deepest mysteries of the Law
questions.explanation: Mark 8:11 (ESV): "The Pharisees came and began to argue with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven to test him."

questions.question: How did Jesus react to the Pharisees demanding a sign from heaven?
options: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, "Truly, I say to you, no sign will be given to this generation."
He rebuked them loudly and showed them fire from his fingertips
He wept and told them they were lost
He ignored them entirely and continued speaking in parables
questions.correctAnswer: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, "Truly, I say to you, no sign will be given to this generation."
questions.explanation: Mark 8:12 (ESV): "And he sighed deeply in his spirit and said, 'Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly, I say to you, no sign will be given to this generation.'"

questions.question: Jesus warned His disciples to "Watch out; beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and..." the leaven of whom?
options: Herod
The Sadducees
The high priest
The tax collectors
questions.explanation: Mark 8:15 (ESV): "And he cautioned them, saying, 'Watch out; beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.'"

questions.question: When the disciples thought Jesus brought up leaven because they had no bread, Jesus reminded them of the miracles of feeding to show they had what?
options: Hardened hearts (eyes that do not see, ears that do not hear)
Poor memory that required writing it down
Lacking trust in His ability to purchase bread
Greedy desires for more food than they needed
questions.correctAnswer: Hardened hearts (eyes that do not see, ears that do not hear)
questions.explanation: Mark 8:17-18 (ESV): "'Are your hearts hardened? Having eyes do you not see, and having ears do you not hear? And do you not remember?'"

questions.question: At Bethsaida, they brought a blind man to Jesus. How did Jesus heal him the first time He laid hands on him?
options: He spit on his eyes and laid his hands on him
He merely spoke the word
He rubbed mud upon his eyelids
He had him wash in a nearby pool
questions.correctAnswer: He spit on his eyes and laid his hands on him
questions.explanation: Mark 8:23 (ESV): "And he took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village, and when he had spit on his eyes and laid his hands on him..."

questions.question: After the first touch, what did the blind man at Bethsaida see?
options: "I see people, but they look like trees, walking."
"I see only shadows moving wildly."
"I see completely clear, but the light is painful."
"My vision is worse than before."
questions.correctAnswer: "I see people, but they look like trees, walking."
questions.explanation: Mark 8:24 (ESV): "And he looked up and said, 'I see people, but they look like trees, walking.'"

questions.question: When Jesus asked His disciples, on the way to Caesarea Philippi, "Who do people say that I am?", what answers did they give?
options: John the Baptist; and others say, Elijah; and others, one of the prophets
The King of Israel, or the Messiah ben Joseph
Enoch returned to life, or Moses
A blasphemer and deceiver
questions.correctAnswer: John the Baptist; and others say, Elijah; and others, one of the prophets
questions.explanation: Mark 8:28 (ESV): "And they told him, 'John the Baptist; and others say, Elijah; and others, one of the prophets.'"

questions.question: When Jesus asked, "But who do you say that I am?", how did Peter answer?
options: "You are the Christ."
"You are the Son of David."
"You are the Holy One of God."
"You are the Prince of Peace."
questions.explanation: Mark 8:29 (ESV): "And he asked them, 'But who do you say that I am?' Peter answered him, 'You are the Christ.'"

questions.question: Jesus began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things. After He said He must be killed and after three days rise again, what did Peter do?
options: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him
Peter loudly praised God for the resurrection
Peter swore to die alongside Him
Peter refused to believe him and walked away
questions.correctAnswer: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him
questions.explanation: Mark 8:31-32 (ESV): "And he said this plainly. And Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him."

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to Peter's rebuke?
options: "Get behind me, Satan! For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man."
"Silence your tongue, for you speak fear instead of faith."
"Blessed are you for caring for me, but it must be done."
"Do you question the will of the Father?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Get behind me, Satan! For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man."
questions.explanation: Mark 8:33 (ESV): "But turning and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter and said, 'Get behind me, Satan! For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man.'"

questions.question: Jesus told the crowd and His disciples: "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his...?"
options: cross and follow me.
yoke and learn from me.
sword and stand firm.
burden without complaining.
questions.explanation: Mark 8:34 (ESV): "...he said to them, 'If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.'"

questions.question: What does Jesus ask regarding what a man gains versus his soul?
options: "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?"
"Is it not better to be poor on earth and rich in heaven?"
"Can a man buy back his spirit with coins of gold?"
"If a man loses his wealth for my sake, does he not gain much more?"
questions.correctAnswer: "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?"
questions.explanation: Mark 8:36 (ESV): "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?"

key_verse_text: And calling the crowd to him with his disciples, he said to them, "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me."
